calls: client-streaming, server-streaming, and bidirectional RPC lifetimes

reference.implementation: gRFC A48 equal-weight least-request contract plus the pinned grpc-core xDS feature declaration
observed_contract: choiceCount defaults to 2, rejects values below 2, and caps effective values at 10
each pick samples READY subchannels with replacement and chooses the sampled subchannel with the fewest active requests
outstanding counters belong to one policy instance and release on every RPC terminal outcome
duplicate resolved addresses create one subchannel and receive no implicit weight
least-request reuses round-robin connectivity aggregation and reconnect ownership

implementation.parser: ordered service-config selection supports least_request_experimental, validates the uint32 domain, applies the A48 default and cap, and composes below outlier detection
implementation.picker: allocation-free power-of-N sampling uses fresh runtime entropy, intentionally permits duplicate samples, and compares exact policy-local outstanding counts
implementation.ordinary_channel: endpoint slots count selected unary attempts and returned streaming lifetimes; the one-shot completion observer shares outlier accounting and releases on OK, error, reset, cancellation, failed receive, or abandoning deinit
implementation.shared_channel: claim increments under the state lock before stream materialization; completion decrements under the same lock; one cached choice survives competing worker wakeups until its exact worker claims the job
implementation.membership: DNS results and exact duplicate pre-resolved endpoints collapse before worker or connection creation; distinct authority, TLS policy, limits, or connector identity remain separate
implementation.non_selected_fast_path: ordinary and shared channels that do not select least-request do not mutate outstanding counters or allocate an extra completion observer
